findings.checklist_item: - [ ] Specify that the REMOVE `reverse` inversion must EXCLUDE vendor types reachable from more than one relation (e.g. Blocks from both blocks and depends_on): an ambiguous vendor type stays relation=None and is left for inbound ADOPT rather than guessed at.
evidence: Plan step 3 REMOVE: 'Build reverse = {v: k for k, v in link_map.items() if v != SKIP}'
Plan step 1 built-in literal: local_to_jira_link = {"blocks":"Blocks","depends_on":"Blocks","relates_to":"Relates"} — Blocks is the value for two distinct relations

The effective link_map returned to the differ retains the built-in entries (resolve_for_project merges builtin), so both blocks->Blocks and depends_on->Blocks are present and the naive inversion collapses them
The snapshot implementation guards this (Counter over vendor values; reverse includes v only when _vendor_counts[v] == 1), confirming the ambiguity is real and must be handled
findings.finding: The plan's REMOVE-attribution reverse map `{v: k for k, v in link_map.items() if v != SKIP}` is a naive inversion that is ambiguous for the built-in link map, where vendor type `Blocks` is reached by BOTH `blocks` and `depends_on`; a remote Blocks link falling through to reverse.get() would be mis-attributed to a single arbitrary relation (last-writer-wins), targeting the wrong local dep on REMOVE.
findings.location: Approach step 3, REMOVE bullet ('Build reverse = {v: k for k, v in link_map.items() if v != SKIP}')
scenarios: A project remaps no link type but a remote Blocks link's direction attribution via JIRA_LINK_TO_RELATION returns None, triggering the reverse.get fallback on an ambiguous Blocks

A managed depends_on link is deliberately unlinked locally; the reverse map attributes the remote Blocks removal to `blocks` instead, so local_deps membership and should_propagate_removal are checked against the wrong (relation, target)
findings.suggested_fix: In step 3 REMOVE, replace the naive inversion with an ambiguity-aware one: count vendor-type occurrences across the SKIP-filtered link_map and build reverse only for vendor types with exactly one source relation; an ambiguous type stays relation=None (adopt inbound), never misattributed.
